title: Minesweeper
tagline: Read the numbers, dodge the mines.
description: Clear every safe tile on a hidden minefield using nothing but the numbers you uncover, flagging the mines as you pin them down. Three board sizes from a nine-wide warm-up to a thirteen-by-seventeen field with 48 mines, and your best time is kept for each.
instructions: Pick a size on the title screen, or tap anywhere to play the last one you used.
Tap a tile to clear it — the first tap is always safe. A number counts the mines touching that tile.
Flag a suspected mine with a long press, a right-click, or by turning on the Flag button; tap a cleared number whose flags all match to open the rest around it.
Arrow keys move the cursor, Space clears, F flags, C chords, R restarts. Your best time per size is stored locally.
